paragraphs: A major global Microsoft outage on Friday the 13th disrupted essential services for hundreds of thousands of users worldwide and affected Outlook, Teams, Microsoft 365, OneDrive, and Copilot.

At the peak of the disruption, a monitoring website recorded over 130,000 reports for Outlook and 46,000 for Microsoft 365. Microsoft said a core process on its servers became overwhelmed and stopped responding, but ruled out a cyberattack and began a gradual recovery. A cybersecurity expert noted that the incident highlights the serious risks of businesses relying on a single technology provider for daily operations. When major cloud platforms fail, companies can lose access to emails, online meetings, and security verification codes, which brings daily work to a standstill.

Experts advise organizations not to put all their eggs in one basket, and urge them to diversify their digital providers and prepare strong backup plans to stay resilient during future technical crashes.

paragraphs: A huge Microsoft system failure on Friday the 13th stopped important services like Outlook, Teams, and Microsoft 365 from working around the world.
More than 130,000 people reported problems with Outlook, and thousands couldn’t send emails or join online meetings.
Microsoft said its computer servers got overloaded and stopped responding, though it confirmed this was not a cyberattack. The company slowly started fixing the problem to bring services back online.

A technology expert explained that this crash shows the danger of businesses depending on just one tech company for all their daily work. He advised companies to use more than one provider and build strong backup plans so that one computer crash doesn’t stop their whole business from operating.

words.d: given too much work, data, or weight to handle properly

paragraphs: A big computer problem at Microsoft stops many services around the world on Friday. People cannot use Outlook email, Teams, or other work apps for hours.
Microsoft says that its main computers have too much work. They stop working. But it is not an attack by hackers. The company starts slowly fixing the problem.

Technology experts say that companies should not use only one big tech company for everything. If one system breaks, people cannot do their jobs. Businesses need good backup plans so they can keep working when a problem comes.

words.d: the biggest or most important thing
an extra copy of data or a plan for a situation when something stops working
